title: Idempotence: The Algebra Behind 'Safe to Re-run'
explainer: Idempotence is a formal property from abstract algebra: an operation f is idempotent if applying it twice gives the same result as applying it once, f(f(x)) = f(x). Infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet) are built around this exact property on purpose - a well-written manifest or plan can be applied repeatedly against the same infrastructure and converge to the same state rather than compounding changes, which is precisely what makes re-running a failed apply safe instead of dangerous.
